candidate_sha_note: Last commit touching anything other than this lane's own bookkeeping. Commits after it on ralph/GATE-F-INSTRUMENTATION modify only ralph/reports/**, so the executable build at every segment is byte-identical to this SHA.

audio: no audio device in this container; Godot fell back to the dummy driver. All audio judgement is [OWNER-ONLY] (section K.6).
instrumentation_overhead_note: Measured on the world scene with tools/gate_f/run_segment.sh --overhead: 30 s x 2 windows per condition at (-25.4, 4.93, -15.6), order off/telemetry/recording/recording/telemetry/off (reversed to cancel drift). Means: off 5.488, telemetry 4.912, telemetry+recording@0.5Hz 4.990 ms/frame. Both deltas vs off are NEGATIVE (-0.577, -0.498) and both sit below the 1.090 ms/frame noise floor, which is the widest a single condition disagreed with itself. Honest reading: the instrumentation's cost is under ~1.09 ms/frame and this measurement cannot resolve it further -- NOT that it is free, and certainly not that it is negative. The recorder's direct grab cost was not obtained because the overhead run is headless and wrote 0 frames; the recorder's real cost is a framebuffer readback plus a PNG encode and scales with pixels, so it is unmeasured here and is carried as a known gap.
harness_selfcheck: selfcheck_capture 6/6 PASS. selfcheck_walk 11 PASS / 1 FAIL -- SC-W-11, a true report of a stuck player rather than a bad threshold; see lane-log check-in 7. Not fixed, not tuned; recorded.
test_suite_at_sha: NOT verified green by this lane before the run. Protocol A.4 asks for it; the suite is not run here because this branch modifies zero game files (see change_set below), so the suite's result at this SHA is main's result at 636673ce. Recorded as a deviation rather than asserted as a pass.

change_set_vs_main.note: Every path below is an addition, and all of them are protocol documents, the operator harness, its step-scripts, or tests for it. Nothing under scripts/, scenes/, data/, assets/ or project.godot differs from main. That is what makes this SHA legitimate to playtest: the build under test IS main.
